title: parameter_hash fingerprints working-tree bytes, so it changes with checkout EOL configuration
severity: LOW (identity field only; no metric, gate or verdict depends on it)
discovered_by: tdm13_replay.py attempt 1 (clean clone, autocrlf inherited as true)
root_cause: tdm12_inventory.py builds parameter_hash from sha256(module.__file__) bytes, i.e. the bytes on disk after checkout filters, not the committed blob id
rectification: re-checked out the clean clone with core.autocrlf=false; bytes then matched the original checkout and parameter_hash reproduced exactly (attempt 2: 10/10 comparisons)
recommended_fix_outside_this_rfc: fingerprint the blob id (git hash-object) or the LF-normalised content instead of working-tree bytes
